transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer support, my name is Maya. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Maya. I'm in a real panic because my mobile voicemail has locked me out, and I'm expecting an urgent call from my hospital consultant this morning with test results.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help you get that voicemail mailbox unlocked, Deena. Before we do, let me quickly verify your account details. Could you confirm your full name and billing address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Deena Patel, 19 Hawthorn Grove, Bristol, BS4 3QN.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Deena. I completely understand how stressful that must be with important medical news pending, so let's get that mailbox unlocked immediately. And what is the security question answer for your mother's maiden name?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It's Desai.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the mobile phone number associated with this SIM card?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: So what I understand is you've been locked out of your mobile voicemail after three incorrect PIN attempts, and we need to reset that security restriction so you can listen to incoming messages today without interruption. Have I got that right?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, exactly. I usually remember my PIN but I was rushing between appointments and must have hit the wrong digits.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That happens all the time. When you dial 123 from your handset right now, what exact recording do you hear?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: It says 'Your mailbox has been locked due to multiple incorrect attempts. Please contact customer services to reactivate your access.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Are you able to receive normal phone calls and SMS text messages on the handset right now?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, regular incoming calls ring normally, and text messages come through without any issues.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously I cannot listen to your private voicemail messages, but I can wipe the failed authentication counter and assign a temporary passcode.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be wonderful. Will my saved greeting be erased?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, resetting the security PIN keeps your recorded greeting and all unplayed messages completely intact.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Oh, that is such a relief. I was terrified I might lose whatever message the doctor left.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am going to take direct ownership of this right now. I'll open our network HLR switch, clear the lock flag, and generate a temporary one-time PIN.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Maya, I really appreciate you taking care of it so quickly.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for about thirty seconds while the profile re-syncs on the core mobile exchange.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for waiting, Deena. The lock flag has cleared on the network register.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Brilliant, what do I need to do on my side?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just confirming before I trigger the security SMS, you want the temporary four-digit PIN sent to the handset ending in 612, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's this handset.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've just dispatched the SMS. It will contain a four-digit temporary code.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Just got the chime. The text says temporary PIN is 5092.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent. Now please dial 123 on your keypad, and let me know when the automated system prompts you.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, dialing 123 now... It's ringing... It's asking for my temporary PIN.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Enter 5092, then press hash.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Done. Now it's asking me to choose a new four-digit PIN that isn't consecutive numbers.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Go ahead and enter a new four-digit PIN that you'll remember easily, followed by the hash key.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Okay, I've entered it twice as requested... It says 'Your new PIN has been successfully saved.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic. Now does the system read out your mailbox menu?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it says 'You have no new messages in your main mailbox. Press 1 to listen to saved messages, or press 2 to change personal options.'

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you confirm you are able to disconnect the call, dial 123 again, and enter your new PIN smoothly?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Let me just test that quickly. Disconnecting... Dialing 123... Prompting for PIN... Entered it... Yes, it went straight into my mailbox menu!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's wonderful news, Deena. Your mailbox is fully operational and secure for when your consultant calls.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: You have taken so much weight off my shoulders this morning, Maya. Thank you ever so much.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Also, would you like me to enable voicemail SMS notification alerts, so you get an immediate text whenever someone leaves a voice note?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, please! Does that cost anything extra on my monthly tariff?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No, voicemail text alerts are completely free of charge on all S-Net pay monthly plans.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be super handy, especially if I'm in a noisy clinic waiting area and don't hear the call ring.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I've toggled SMS notification to active on your account profile now. It takes effect immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That gives me extra peace of mind. Thank you for thinking of that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your billing email address while we have the account open, it's deena dot patel at outlook dot com, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can also manage your voicemail greeting through the My S-Net mobile app under Account Settings as well.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Good to know, I've got the app installed on my phone.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And your mobile handset has forty gigabytes of data remaining on this billing cycle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is plenty for my needs.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can I help you with any other aspect of your S-Net service today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No, everything else is running smoothly. Thank you again for your patience.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was my absolute pleasure. Thank you for choosing S-Net, and I hope everything goes smoothly with your results today, Deena.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Maya, have a lovely day.
